integrity_statement: Analytical proof and standalone finite symbolic/numerical checks included. Finite calculations do not certify the asymptotic theorem. Publicly known related cases are credited. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The uniform remainder is for fixed positive beta and positive gamma, possibly gamma varying with amplitude; no beta-to-zero uniformity. Known gamma-equals-zero period laws are not claimed as original. Period uniqueness is restricted to this cubic family. Literature priority remains conditional on the finite comparison.
title: Uniform two-term period crossover in a cubic global-center family
